newsitem.title: UK: BBA unit spends $18.5 mln on U.S. bases.
newsitem.headline: BBA unit spends $18.5 mln on U.S. bases.

text.p: BBA Group Plc said its subsidiary Signature Flight Support Corporation had bought three fixed base operations (FBOs) from private U.S. firm International Aviation for $18.5 million.
In a statement, the company said sales for the three bases for the year ending December 31, 1996, were $29.3 million.
The three bases are at Teterboro Airport, New Jersey, White Plains in New York and West Palm Beach in Florida.
These three bring the number of Signature's network of fixed base operations to 41, including a Swiss joint venture, the company said in a statement.
